messages:
sara.kim: Quick sync — new model intake for 'harbor-13b' landed in the repo. Need prioritization for quant experiments, catalog entry, docs, and a short launch announcement. Can we slot this into the next cadence?

mike.chen: +1. Is 4-bit (Q4) the goal or do we run Q8/Q4 compare first? I can run a fast Q8 baseline tonight.

laura.ortiz: I'd vote for Q8 first for a quick quality baseline, then Q4 if perf gains look promising. Also we should run the standard RAG and safety eval sets.

sara.kim: Plan: 1) quick Q8 accuracy/latency pass (mike) 2) Q4 quant job (if Q8 decent) 3) full eval harness (laura) 4) catalog + one-pager draft (eva) 5) announcement draft for #announcements.

mike.chen: On it. I'll spin up a devdedicated job: model=harbor-13b, batch=8, seq=1024. Command: ```run_quant_bench --model harbor-13b --quant q8 --batch 8 --seq 1024 --metrics latency,perplexity``` Will post logs here. ETA: ~10h.

laura.ortiz: For eval harness add these suites: lm_eval (ppl), rouge, multilang-sensitivity, toxicity-regs. I'll start the RAG retrieval eval tomorrow morning.

eva: Catalog entry sketch (will fill details after mike's numbers): ```slug: harbor-13b
name: Harbor 13B (base)
params: 13B
recommended_quant: q8 -> q4 after validation
recommended_batching: throughput:32 latency-SLO:150ms
example_prompt: "Summarize the following document in two bullets."
compatibility_tags: [causal, chat, embeddings?]
notes: preliminary; pass safety check before public mention```

sara.kim: Nice. Also need owner tags and rollout policy. Proposed: owner=@eng-ml, rollout: canary 10% for hosted then full. Add fallback to harbor-13b-q4-fallback if Q8 falls below quality.

ops-bot: Reminder: please file a ./docs/ops/runbook entry for model bring-up. Template: ops/runbooks/model-onboard.md

mike.chen: Log snippet from quick Q8 run: ```latency_p50: 82ms
latency_p95: 210ms
ppl: 12.4
mem_gpu: 10.2GB``` Looks promising on p50 but p95 needs attention at seq1024. Will try seq512 next.

laura.ortiz: If p95 jumps we should tune batching or use prefix-KV caching for interactive route. I'll run regression checks vs our baseline (raptor-11b).

eva: Announcement checklist (draft): - draft one-paragraph summary + small benchmark gif - update model-catalog page - blog blurb for customers (short) - internal launch note to #product and #sales - schedule release window (prefer Thurs AM for infra ops).

sara.kim: Good. Action items: mike -> Q8 + seq512 numbers; laura -> full eval suites; eva -> catalog + announcement draft; sara -> coordinate canary window + support on rollout. We'll reconvene 24h. 

dev-bot: Deploy job queued for harbor-13b:dev-q8 on devdedicated-3. Job id: d-84721.

mike.chen: Job started. Pasting final numbers when done.

laura.ortiz: I'll open a short issue in GH: `eng-ml/harbor-13b-onboard` linking docs, eval outputs, and the catalog PR.

sara.kim: Thanks all — appreciate quick turn. If any major regressions, flag in this thread and we postpone announcement. :thumbsup:
